cases.text: My invoice lists the same charge twice. Please correct it during normal business hours; nothing is blocked.
Please send a receipt for last month's payment. There is no deadline and the software works normally.
I cancelled an unused subscription and want to ask about a refund. This can wait until next week.
The invoice shows the premium plan, but I selected the basic plan. Please check the charge when convenient.
Every employee is locked out of our production account right now. Business operations have stopped. We need immediate technical help.
The app is currently showing one customer another customer's private records. This is an active security incident and needs immediate technical response.
How can I increase the font size in the desktop app? Everything works; this is a nonurgent usability question.
A toolbar icon disappeared after the app update, but all functions still work. It can be investigated next week.
Where is the button for exporting a report? I am learning the software and do not need an immediate response.
Our payment was received but has not been credited. The account will be suspended in ten minutes unless billing fixes the payment record immediately.
Could someone take a look at my account?
I need help but have not described the issue yet.
